description: Engine profile resolution (E4a): release defaults narrowed by the org ceiling, the agent and the request, in that order; one table for Node (domain/engine-profiles.ts) and Python (harness_core.engines.profiles). `release` is what this release ships (harness_engines/allowlist.json, Node's RELEASE_ENGINE_PROFILES). `releases` are the engines the cases resolve against: two native, one ACP agent (acp-<agent>), and an older opencode version beside the first (C14.01: an engine's first entry is its default version; `kind@version` picks another). A case's `acpOptIn` says who opts an ACP engine in (absent: `release`, every released one, where no org can set a ceiling; `org`, only one the org's ceiling names, ACP-driver). A refusal is `widening` (naming the first dimension in registry order and the layer) or `invalid` (a layer that is not a narrowing: unknown key, null, repeated item). `profileDigest` is the canonical digest of `profile` (executor.engine.profileDigest).

cases.behaviour: no layer: the first release engine with the release defaults
the org admits only the second engine: it runs
the org admits both, the agent picks one by version
the agent asks for an engine the org left out
an engine version nobody released
the org raises the isolation floor and the agent raises it further
the agent lowers the org's isolation floor
an isolation of the same rank is a narrowing
plan narrows build
build after plan widens
review after plan widens
egress none stays none
an egress allowlist over none widens
tool ceilings narrow layer by layer
more tools than the layer above
a read-only tool grant
an effect class the org left out
limits from three layers combine
a step limit above the org's
a step limit above the release's
a cost limit above the org's
a limit the release leaves unlimited can be set, then only lowered
sub-agents on when the release has them off
sub-agents off again is a narrowing
reasoning effort narrows, then a higher one widens
any effort when the release sets none
the org denies writes; the agent may not relax that to ask
approvals made stricter per class
writes allowed without asking widens the release
skills narrow to a subset, then a skill outside it widens
any skill set narrows the release's 'any'
a layer that widens twice is refused on the first dimension in registry order
a null limit (asking for unlimited) is invalid
an unknown dimension is invalid
a repeated engine is invalid
the stage 1 read-only task narrowing
an org ceiling on every dimension, an empty agent layer
an empty skill set is a narrowing (no skills)
an empty effect set is a narrowing (no gateway tools)
A1 EP-A1: the org narrows accountKinds to the org's own key
A1 EP-A1: org then request narrow accountKinds; the narrowest applies
A1 EP-A2: a kind the release does not offer (a consumer plan) is a widening
A1 EP-A2: a request asking back a kind the org removed is a widening
A1: an empty or repeated accountKinds list is not a narrowing
an agent asks for an ACP engine the org never named: refused at the agent
the org names the ACP engine beside a native one, the agent picks it
the org names only the ACP engine by version: it runs
the org names native engines only: the ACP engine stays out even for an agent with no engines
the org's ceiling names no engines: only the native engines are candidates
two versions of one engine: the kind resolves to its first (default) version
the org turns the default version off: the kind resolves to the version it left on
a chat held to a version the org turned off is refused on that layer (admission then moves the chat to the default)
no org can opt engines in: an agent's ACP engine is a candidate with no ceiling
no org can opt engines in: a ceiling that names no engines leaves the ACP engine a candidate
no org can opt engines in: a ceiling that lists engines still leaves out an ACP engine it does not name
no org can opt engines in: with no layer the first release engine still runs
